topic: Good debt vs bad debt (Rhys vs Della)

scenes.narration: Not all debt is sick, but the wrong kind can poison your finances fast. I am Doctor Dollar. Today's patient checkup starts here.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named doctor dollar, dark curly hair, round gold-rim glasses, kind smile, white doctor coat over teal scrubs, golden stethoscope shaped like a dollar sign, holding a clipboard with a credit-score chart, doctor dollar in an exam room beside two vials marked GOOD DEBT and BAD DEBT, comic burst banner reads DEBT CHECKUP, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Rhys and Della both take on ten thousand dollars of debt.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel of man rhys and woman della each holding a paper stamped TEN THOUSAND DEBT, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Good debt builds value, bad debt just drains your wallet.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, doctor dollar holding a chart with GOOD DEBT rising and BAD DEBT falling, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Rhys borrows for a fancy vacation and a new gadget.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man rhys holding beach tickets and a shiny gadget, a card stamped BAD DEBT, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: His debt charges twenty four percent and buys nothing lasting.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a red interest meter pinned at TWENTY FOUR PERCENT, worried man rhys beside fading purchases, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Della instead borrows money to earn a skilled trade certification.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman della holding a certificate stamped TRADE SKILL, a card labeled GOOD DEBT, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Her low interest loan steadily raises her future earning power.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman della beside a rising income arrow labeled HIGHER EARNINGS, a green LOW INTEREST tag, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Rhys still owes the full balance with nothing to show.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, glum man rhys holding a bill stamped STILL OWES, empty hands, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Della pays off her loan and keeps the higher salary.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, smiling woman della tearing a paper stamped PAID OFF beside a fat paycheck, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Rhys's bad debt drags his net worth into the red.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a net worth meter dropping into the RED zone, man rhys watching, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Della's good debt instead pushes her net worth steadily upward.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a net worth meter climbing into the GREEN zone, smiling woman della beside it, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Borrow for things that grow, never for things that fade. See you next visit. Stay financially healthy!
